content.introduction: UBS downgraded Roche stock to neutral on valuation concerns, while Deutsche Bank upgraded Roche from Hold to Buy citing positive oncology survey feedback and a price target of CHF500.00. RBC Capital reiterated its Outperform rating with a price target of CHF400.00, noting strong momentum and revenue forecasts exceeding consensus by 2.7%. Roche's financials show an annual revenue of 61.52B CHF and a market cap of 223.06B CHF as of 2024-10-29.
body:
In other recent news, Roche Holding has been the subject of several analyst updates. Deutsche Bank upgraded Roche from Hold to Buy, citing positive feedback from an oncology survey and adjusting its price target to CHF500.00. This upgrade followed the company’s third-quarter results. Meanwhile, RBC Capital reiterated its Outperform rating with a price target of CHF400.00, noting strong momentum and revenue forecasts that exceed consensus by 2.7%.
